tasks.title: PLAN HANDS EACH TASK'S ROUTING TO AN OPTIONAL CALLBACK, ONCE PER TASK IN GRAPH ORDER, WITHOUT CHANGING ONE BYTE OF ITS TEXT
TICKMARKR START TURNS ONE SENTENCE INTO A DRAFTED SPEC, A COMPILED GRAPH AND A ROUTED PLAN, AND SHOWS IT AS A STORY-FIRST CARD
INIT AND THE README QUICKSTART POINT A NEW USER AT TICKMARKR START FIRST, KEEPING THE HAND-WRITTEN SPEC PATH AS THE ALTERNATIVE
